run_linear_probe_evaluation: run linear probe evaluation on a pretrained CLIP model with configurable dataset and architecture
train_model_frozen_features: train only the linear classifier head while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen
evaluate_model_validation: evaluate the linear classifier on the validation set and report top-1 and top-5 accuracy
adjust_learning_rate_cosine: adjust the learning rate using a cosine annealing schedule over the training epochs
save_checkpoint_best_model: save model checkpoint and copy to best model file when validation accuracy improves
